summary: [standards] Three edge cases of a path in the wrong state, driven by hand: (a) canon.yaml is a directory -> CONFIG_REQUIRED 'no canon.yaml in ...' (EISDIR should be CONFIG_INVALID by the rule that a wrong path is INVALID; the F1 failure path of the brief says a directory in place of a file is _INVALID), found in `require_config`, not touched by this change; (b) the change directory at mode 000 -> `brief show` and `brief check` answer BRIEF_NOT_FOUND 'no brief at ...' because `resolve_change` asks `exists()` (false on EACCES); it is BRIEF_DENIED; (c) `canon artifacts verify` with a store directory that is a directory-in-place of a blob or at mode 000 exits 0 (working-tree-only counts as stored), unrelated to the codes but worth knowing when reading atip.codestored.07.
